{{otheruses|the [[legendary weapon]]|the [[warrior]] skill|Frenzy (warrior skill)|other uses|Frenzy (disambiguation)}} {{Weapon infobox | type = Harpoon gun | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = legendary | prefix = selectable | uslot = Superior Sigil of Rage | bound = account use | skin = Frenzy (skin); Rage (skin); The Stingray (skin); Rage Experiment (skin) | id = 30697 | gallery2 = Frenzy stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Frenzy stowed }} [[Frenzy]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] harpoon gun crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Although the vast, impenetrable [[Unending Ocean]] has been left unexplored for a century past, fishermen lingering just outside the expanse often catch glimpses of something magnificent.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | name = Frenzy | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Rage (weapon) | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Frenzy | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Frenzy]] is a rainbow fish harpoon gun. Bright bubbles flow through the gun, and tiny rainbow fish - similar in design to the gun itself - periodically spawn near the player. ;Aura * The user is surrounded by bubbles, scales, and a swarm of small rainbow fish while the weapon is drawn. Small purple dots flicker around the user and the weapon ;Draw effect * Similar to [[Kraitkin]] a red aura appears that changes to blue and emanates from the user's body. ;Stow effect * Several small fish spawn near the player. If stowed from being wielded, nearly all of the rainbow fish will swim away and vanish. ;Skill effects * Default projectiles are replaced with a larger rainbow fish. === Gallery === File:Frenzy aura.jpg|The bubble aura and fish particle effect around the player. File:Frenzy drawn.jpg|The red aura that appears when Frenzy is drawn File:Frenzy projectile.jpg|Modified projectiles.
